description: MaaS Global schemas publish shared type definitions and validation code for mobility-as-a-service APIs. The repository README identifies independent npm packages for data schemas and an AJV-based JSON Schema validator. Developers can encode journeys, service or provider messages in the defined structure and check them before exchange between systems. Geographic coverage depends on the MaaS service implementing the schema, not a bundled network. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing. A limitation is that schema compliance does not establish correct schedules, accessible service, fare availability or consistency between operators. Implementers must also inspect the package version used by a partner. The schemas can help combine transport-service inputs for multimodal accessibility or digital-twin simulation. The related catalogue AequilibraE record models transport networks but is not the same data-exchange specification. No npm package or service data was downloaded.
